annotations.title: How much do you really earn?

description: Drivaron, the ride-hail driver's advisor for earning more. Net income calculator for ride-hail drivers (Uber, inDrive, DiDi, Cabify, Yango) in Spanish-speaking Latin America: from earnings, hours and costs (fuel, commission, car rent) it gives net income per day, week and month, net per hour, and how it compares with the city's typical target and starting minimum per km. Use it when a driver asks how much they make, whether driving pays, or how to compare apps or shifts.

city.description: City, which sets currency, starting hourly target, average speed and starting minimum per km. One of: Bogotá, Medellín, Cali, Barranquilla, Cartagena, Bucaramanga, Cúcuta, Ibagué, Soacha, Santa Marta, Villavicencio, Pereira, Manizales, Pasto, Neiva, Armenia, Montería, Valledupar, Popayán, Sincelejo, Lima, Arequipa, Trujillo, Chiclayo, Cusco, Santa Cruz de la Sierra, La Paz, Cochabamba, El Alto, Tarija, Ciudad de México, Guadalajara, Monterrey, Puebla, Tijuana, Querétaro, Mérida, León, Cancún, Buenos Aires, Córdoba, Rosario, Mendoza, La Plata, San Miguel de Tucumán, Santiago, Valparaíso y Viña del Mar, Concepción, Antofagasta, La Serena, Temuco, Quito, Guayaquil, Cuenca, Ambato, Manta, Machala, Ciudad de Guatemala, Mixco, Villa Nueva, Quetzaltenango, Asunción, Ciudad del Este, Encarnación, Montevideo, Maldonado y Punta del Este, Santo Domingo, Santiago de los Caballeros, San José, Alajuela, Heredia, Ciudad de Panamá, San Salvador, Santa Ana, Tegucigalpa, San Pedro Sula, Caracas, Maracaibo, Valencia.

commission_pct.description: Commission in % still to subtract, if earnings are before commission. Default 0.

country.description: Country when the city is unknown, by name, ISO code or currency: Colombia (CO, COP), Peru (PE, PEN), Bolivia (BO, BOB), Mexico (MX, MXN), Argentina (AR, ARS), Chile (CL, CLP), Ecuador (EC, USD), Guatemala (GT, GTQ), Paraguay (PY, PYG), Uruguay (UY, UYU), Dominican Republic (DO, DOP), Costa Rica (CR, CRC), Panama (PA, USD), El Salvador (SV, USD), Honduras (HN, HNL), Venezuela (VE, USD).

currency.description: Currency, when neither city nor country is known.

days_per_week.description: Days worked per week, to project week and month. Default 6.

earnings.description: Earnings in the period from the apps, in local currency.

fuel_cost.description: Total fuel spent in the period.

fuel_cost_per_km.description: Fuel cost per km (used with km).

fuel_price.description: Fuel price per gallon or liter (used with km and km_per_fuel_unit).

hours.description: Hours worked in that period (online time).

km.description: Km driven in the period, for fuel and cost per km.

km_per_fuel_unit.description: Km the car drives per gallon or liter of the fuel_price unit.

lang.description: Language of the summary: es (default) or en.

other_costs.description: Other costs in the period: car rent, maintenance, phone plan, parking.

period.description: Period of earnings and hours: day (default), week or month.

name: estimate_driver_income

app.description: The Drivaron app and its Play download link.

color.description: green, yellow or red for offers.

result.description: All numbers, raw and formatted in local currency.

summary.description: One-paragraph answer in the requested language, ready to show the driver.
